name: A Sampling of Putrescence
summary: Kelek Skykeeper seeks organs from Felwood’s afflicted wolves and bears to study the corruption in their waters. The samples may show how it harms the creatures.

sections.title: Kelek's Samples
sections.body: Felwood’s corrupted waters reach its wolves and bears, and Kelek Skykeeper needs samples to understand the harm. You are asked to bring him organs from both kinds of creature. The corruption leaves them ferocious, diseased, and fearless.

sections.title: What the Samples Show
sections.body: Kelek finds tumors and pustules on the organs you bring him. He believes the animals’ pain drives their aggression, but he does not know how to cure them. He suspects the answer lies on Hyjal, while Felwood suffers the corruption’s effects.

faq.q: What does Kelek want from me?
faq.answer: Kelek asks for samples from Felwood’s afflicted bears and wolves so he can study the corruption.
Corruption from Hyjal flows through the mountain’s waters and seeps into Felwood. Animals that drink the water take it into themselves.

faq.q: What does the corruption do to the creatures?
faq.answer: It makes the creatures ferocious, diseased, and fearless.
Kelek believes tumors and pustules cause the animals excruciating pain, which drives their aggression.

faq.q: Does Kelek know how to cure them?
faq.answer: Kelek does not know how to cure the animals. He suspects the solution lies on Hyjal.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Sampling of Putrescence
